title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These - Sakubou

date-tvdb.reason: AniDB lists Die Neue These Sakubou as three films; TVDB 343237 season 4 lists them as twelve TV episodes, four per film, the first of each group airing the day before its film (S4E1 2022-09-29, E5 2022-10-27, E9 2022-11-24). Film 1 = S4E1-E4 ("Fortress vs. Fortress Akt IV" to "Maze"), film 2 = S4E5-E8 ("The Die Is Cast" to "Departure"), film 3 = S4E9-E12 ("Emperor Overthrown" to "The Occupation of Fezzan"). Only the dates of the later episodes in each group differ.
